question: The diameter of the base of a right-circular cylinder is 12 cm and the height of the cylinder is 2.45 times the radius of its base. Find the volume of the cylinder. [Use pi = {{22} over 7}]
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the base of a cylinder = 12/2 = 6 cm 

Height of the cylinder = 2.45 × 6 = 14.7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Cylinder volume = π × (radius)² × height 

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Volume = π × (6)2 × 14.7

⇒ Volume = 22/7 × 36 × 14.7

⇒ Volume = 22 × 36 × 2.1 = 1663.2 cm3 

**∴ The volume of the cylinder is 1663.2 cm3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**
